{"id":1976151342,"question_id":4280,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months, 1 week","timestamp":1775976518,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1976151342/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Digit Appearances","memory":"37.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int countDigitOccurrences(vector<int>& nums, int digit) {\n        int ans = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            int num = nums[i];\n            while(num > 0)\n            {\n                int d = num % 10;\n                if(d == digit) ans++;\n                num /= 10;\n            }\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-digit-appearances","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1919}
